category.name: Charts
category.preferred_workflow: Always call DocumentBuilder.InsertChart with a valid ChartType, verify shape.HasChart before accessing the Chart property, clear any default series, then populate data using Chart.Series.Add overloads that accept category labels and value arrays; when placing a chart inside a table, balance the table constructs (StartTable, InsertCell, EndRow, EndTable) before saving; bootstrap any required DOCX, folder, or stream inputs locally at the start of the example.

strict_api_bans: Do not treat a generic Shape as a chart unless shape.HasChart is true.
Do not reference members that are not part of Aspose.Words.Chart, such as CategoryAxis, ChartLegend.IsVisible, or Trendline APIs.
Do not add or remove series without first clearing or validating the existing series collection.
canonical_patterns: Insert charts with DocumentBuilder.InsertChart using the required ChartType enumeration.
When a task mentions an existing file, paragraph, chart, stream, or folder, create a local sample DOCX or directory at the beginning of the example.
Validate that each series has a matching number of category labels and values before saving.
Balance table state (StartTable, InsertCell, EndRow, EndTable) before document save.
nullable_warning_prevention: Initialize all non-nullable reference-type fields or use the null-forgiving operator to satisfy the compiler.
Guard any potentially null nodes (e.g., builder.CurrentParagraph?.ParentNode) with explicit null checks before dereferencing.
Declare locals as nullable when a value may be absent and perform a null-check prior to use.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Code accesses Shape.Chart without confirming shape.HasChart, leading to CS1061 errors.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The example treats any Shape as a chart regardless of its actual content.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Add a shape.HasChart check and throw a clear exception if the shape does not contain a chart.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always guard chart access with if (shape.HasChart) { ... } else { throw new InvalidOperationException(...); }.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails with CS1061 or CS0246 for members such as CategoryAxis, ChartLegend.IsVisible, Trendline, or DataLabel properties that do not exist in Aspose.Words.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code references API members that are part of other libraries (e.g., Aspose.Slides) or older versions of Aspose.Words.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Replace the invalid members with the supported Aspose.Words equivalents, or omit the unsupported functionality.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Consult the Aspose.Words 26.10.0 documentation for the exact Chart API surface before writing code.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Saving the document throws runtime errors because the table construction (StartTable/InsertCell/EndRow/EndTable) is not balanced.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The example leaves an open table row or cell when inserting a chart.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Ensure that every StartTable is paired with EndTable and that each InsertCell is followed by EndRow before saving.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Wrap chart insertion inside a clearly delimited table block and call builder.EndRow() and builder.EndTable() after the chart is placed.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Examples that reference external DOCX files, folders, or streams fail at runtime because the inputs do not exist.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code assumes pre-existing files or directories without creating them in the sample.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Create a minimal DOCX, directory, or memory stream at the start of the example and use it for subsequent operations.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always include a self-contained bootstrap section that generates any required input artifacts.

common_failure_patterns.pattern: Incorrect overload usage for builder navigation
common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS7036 errors occur when calling DocumentBuilder.MoveToParagraph without providing the required characterIndex argument.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The example uses an overload that no longer exists or omits required parameters.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Use the overload MoveToParagraph(paragraphIndex, characterIndex) with both arguments, or move the builder by referencing the target Paragraph node directly.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Refer to the current Aspose.Words API for the correct overload signatures before invoking navigation methods.

narrative.overview: The Charts category of Aspose.Words supplies native APIs for creating, customizing, and exporting chart objects inside Word documents. The verified examples illustrate inserting various chart types, populating data from arrays, cloning chart shapes, embedding charts in table cells, and dynamically swapping chart types while respecting the library's supported API surface.
narrative.purpose: Guide the AI coding agent to produce correct, compile-time-safe Aspose.Words chart code by enforcing the native chart workflow, applying documented API contracts, and avoiding the common misuse patterns that cause compilation failures.
validation_priorities: Prioritize compile-time validation of API members and nullability before runtime execution.
maintenance_notes: Periodically review Aspose.Words release notes to update the list of supported chart members and adjust the strict API bans accordingly.
